reading.body:
No operating data center could be confirmed at this address. The coordinates resolve to an unrelated home-services business. No company website, business registration, or press coverage exists for Accelera Data Systems. The entry is filed as unconfirmed.

This entry demonstrates a limit in public data on data center infrastructure. OpenStreetMap tags can persist after the facilities they describe close or relocate. A researcher checking this address today finds a garage door service company, not computing equipment or power infrastructure. Without a working website, regulatory filing, or news coverage, there is no basis to count this location as operational capacity.

Without independent confirmation of operating status and published power specifications, this facility cannot be ranked among Arizona's infrastructure or included in regional capacity totals. Arizona has four facilities with published power figures totaling 512 MW. This one remains unmapped until the operator or a third-party source documents actual hardware deployment and demand.
